# WHO Digital Health Boundaries

WHO guidance on digital health interventions emphasizes that digital tools are not substitutes for functioning health systems. Implementation should consider benefits, harms, acceptability, feasibility, equity, privacy, and the surrounding service context.

For this project, that means the agent can support practice and information access, but it should not present itself as a replacement for real-world services or professional care.
